{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace RateLimiter

/-- A single rate-limiting request: time `at` and token `amount`. -/
inductive Request where
  | mk (at : Nat) (amount : Nat)

/-- The full input to the rate limiter. -/
structure Input where
  capacity : Nat
  period : Nat
  rate : Nat
  requests : List Request

/-- The output of the rate limiter. -/
structure Output where
  accepted : List Bool
  balances : List Nat
  denominator : Nat

/-- Precondition: the input conforms to the specified schema. -/
def valid (inp : Input) : Prop :=
  inp.period > 0 ∧
  (∀ r ∈ inp.requests, r.at ≥ 0) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ inp.requests, r.amount ≥ 0) ∧
  (∀ r₁ r₂, r₁ ∈ inp.requests → r₂ ∈ inp.requests → r₁.at ≤ r₂.at → r₁.at ≤ r₂.at)

/-- Reference implementation of the token-bucket rate limiter. -/
def solve (inp : Input) : Output :=
  let period := inp.period
  let capacity := inp.capacity
  let rate := inp.rate
  let requests := inp.requests
  let denom := period
  let cap_scaled := capacity * period
  let rate_scaled := rate * period
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : List Bool) (bal : List Nat) (tokens : Nat) (t : Nat) : Output :=
    if h : i < requests.length then
      let r := requests.get! i
      let dt := r.at - t
      let refill := dt * rate_scaled
      let new_tokens := min (tokens + refill) cap_scaled
      let amt_scaled := r.amount * period
      let ok : Bool := new_tokens ≥ amt_scaled
      let final_tokens : Nat := if ok then new_tokens - amt_scaled else new_tokens
      loop (i + 1) (acc ++ [ok]) (bal ++ [final_tokens]) final_tokens r.at
    else
      { accepted := acc, balances := bal, denominator := denom }
  loop 0 [] [] cap_scaled 0

/-- O1: The bucket starts full at time zero. -/
theorem thm_O1 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  let cap_scaled := inp.capacity * inp.period
  let first_balance : Nat := if h₁ : inp.requests.length > 0 then out.balances.get! 0 else cap_scaled
  let first_req := if h₁ : inp.requests.length > 0 then inp.requests.get! 0 else Request.mk 0 0
  let dt := first_req.at - 0
  let refill := dt * (inp.rate * inp.period)
  let expected := min (cap_scaled + refill) cap_scaled
  let amt_scaled := first_req.amount * inp.period
  let expected_final : Nat := if expected ≥ amt_scaled then expected - amt_scaled else expected
  first_balance = expected_final := by sorry

/-- O2: The bucket refills continuously at rate/period tokens per time unit, capped at capacity. -/
theorem thm_O2 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  let period := inp.period
  let cap_scaled := inp.capacity * period
  let rate_scaled := inp.rate * period
  ∀ i : Nat, i < inp.requests.length →
    let r := inp.requests.get! i
    let prev_tokens : Nat := if i = 0 then cap_scaled else out.balances.get! (i - 1)
    let dt := r.at - (if i = 0 then 0 else (inp.requests.get! (i - 1)).at)
    let refill := dt * rate_scaled
    let new_tokens := min (prev_tokens + refill) cap_scaled
    let amt_scaled := r.amount * period
    let ok : Bool := new_tokens ≥ amt_scaled
    let final_tokens : Nat := if ok then new_tokens - amt_scaled else new_tokens
    out.balances.get! i = final_tokens := by sorry

/-- O3: A request succeeds iff enough tokens exist, and deducts amount only on success. -/
theorem thm_O3 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  let period := inp.period
  let cap_scaled := inp.capacity * period
  let rate_scaled := inp.rate * period
  ∀ i : Nat, i < inp.requests.length →
    let r := inp.requests.get! i
    let prev_tokens : Nat := if i = 0 then cap_scaled else out.balances.get! (i - 1)
    let dt := r.at - (if i = 0 then 0 else (inp.requests.get! (i - 1)).at)
    let refill := dt * rate_scaled
    let new_tokens := min (prev_tokens + refill) cap_scaled
    let amt_scaled := r.amount * period
    let ok : Bool := new_tokens ≥ amt_scaled
    let final_tokens : Nat := if ok then new_tokens - amt_scaled else new_tokens
    (out.accepted.get! i = ok) ∧
    (if ok then final_tokens = new_tokens - amt_scaled else final_tokens = new_tokens) := by sorry

/-- O4: Failed requests retain the refilled balance. -/
theorem thm_O4 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  let period := inp.period
  let cap_scaled := inp.capacity * period
  let rate_scaled := inp.rate * period
  ∀ i : Nat, i < inp.requests.length →
    let r := inp.requests.get! i
    let prev_tokens : Nat := if i = 0 then cap_scaled else out.balances.get! (i - 1)
    let dt := r.at - (if i = 0 then 0 else (inp.requests.get! (i - 1)).at)
    let refill := dt * rate_scaled
    let new_tokens := min (prev_tokens + refill) cap_scaled
    let amt_scaled := r.amount * period
    let ok : Bool := new_tokens ≥ amt_scaled
    ¬ ok → out.balances.get! i = new_tokens := by sorry

/-- O5: All arithmetic uses exact integers scaled by the denominator (no floating point). -/
theorem thm_O5 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  out.denominator = inp.period := by sorry

/-- O6: balances[i] = (tokens_after_request_i) * period. -/
theorem thm_O6 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  let period := inp.period
  let cap_scaled := inp.capacity * period
  let rate_scaled := inp.rate * period
  ∀ i : Nat, i < inp.requests.length →
    let r := inp.requests.get! i
    let prev_tokens : Nat := if i = 0 then cap_scaled else out.balances.get! (i - 1)
    let dt := r.at - (if i = 0 then 0 else (inp.requests.get! (i - 1)).at)
    let refill := dt * rate_scaled
    let new_tokens := min (prev_tokens + refill) cap_scaled
    let amt_scaled := r.amount * period
    let ok : Bool := new_tokens ≥ amt_scaled
    let final_tokens : Nat := if ok then new_tokens - amt_scaled else new_tokens
    out.balances.get! i = final_tokens := by sorry

/-- O7: The denominator in the output is equal to the input period. -/
theorem thm_O7 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  out.denominator = inp.period := by sorry

/-- O8: The accepted array contains a Boolean for each request indicating success. -/
theorem thm_O8 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  out.accepted.length = inp.requests.length := by sorry

/-- O9: The function preserves the specified input/output structure and exact ordering. -/
theorem thm_O9 (inp : Input) (h : valid inp) :
  let out := solve inp
  out.accepted.length = inp.requests.length ∧
  out.balances.length = inp.requests.length := by sorry

/-- Non-vacuity: valid success and error cases exist under the preconditions. -/
theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (inp : Input), valid inp ∧
    let out := solve inp
    ∃ i : Nat, i < inp.requests.length ∧ out.accepted.get! i = true ∧
    ∃ j : Nat, j < inp.requests.length ∧ out.accepted.get! j = false := by sorry

end RateLimiter",
